source: Fanti et al. 2015, PLOS ONE 10(4): e0123475, Figure 23: S-DIVA biogeography tree (Bayesian topology) with pie-chart nodes and a dispersal/vicariance curve above a stage timescale; 29 tips. Katepensaurus, Nigersaurus and the Demandasaurus clade sit on one vertical carrying two stacked pies: read as (Katepensaurus,(Nigersaurus,(Demandasaurus,(Rebbachisaurus,Tataouinea)))), two nodes at zero length. Image: embedded image at native resolution, unmodified (1937x1691 px). Gold tree and name list from the Open Paleo corpus session (2026-10-29).
